descriptions.text: Surefire. Crafting item. A Surefire adds the “Guided” status to any projectile, powered or not. It may be utilized on a vast array of crafting tables. If added to an arrow or bolt, you must choose a target prior to unleashing the weapon, and the projectile will seek that target. If added to a trap, additional options become available. Such as “Target any healers within range” or “Target anyone who thinks it’s okay to put mayonnaise on hotdogs.” If added to a powered weapon, such as an explosive-based rocket, targets may be assigned during the crafting process or upon firing, but not both. Note: this upgrade alone does not add range to the projectile.

beats.headline: Twenty-five bottle caps
beats.text: Carl's gold sniper's box holds a crafting item: a case of twenty-five small black items, each about the size of a bottle cap. A Surefire adds the Guided status to any projectile, powered or not. On an arrow or a bolt, the target is chosen before the shot; on a trap, new options open up; on a rocket, targets are set while crafting or on firing, but not both. It adds no range. Cool, Carl says, and moves on to his platinum boxes.

beats.headline: Twenty-five more
beats.text: Alone with Donut in the crafting room, Carl opens the silver boss box from killing Ruckus. First comes a case of twenty-five more surefires, which is a relief. He has already used ten of the first ones to give his missiles the guided upgrade, and he was about to use the rest. This gives them some wiggle room, and he can alter the plan.

beats.headline: Locked on the escorts
beats.text: While the gnomes' balloon sat on the ground, Langley handed out targets, and the six archers plus Louis and Firas used the surefire aiming system to lock their missiles onto the circling escort planes and balloons. On Carl's order, eight rockets corkscrew up from the surface, each launcher tube carrying two, and four more blast into the air at the remaining planes before the first salvo even hits.

beats.headline: Five by five
beats.text: Carl sets a multi-launcher the size of a poker table against a hedge: twenty-five single-stage surefire missiles in a five-by-five grid, targets already programmed, on a remote trigger. When he clicks it, the first five streak after the fleeing hunter Xindy. The fourth is shot down early; the fifth hits as her shield fails, and she explodes. The rest spread off in different directions. His second rocket box holds only ten rockets, because he ran out of surefires, and is pre-set to kill the closest hunter-class mobs.
